about: API rates for `telemetry.py cost`, an API-equivalent estimate: never a subscription's spend. Prices per million tokens, from the provider's published pricing, each with the date it applies from and its source. Entry shape: {"provider": "anthropic", "model": "<model id as recorded>", "currency": "USD", "input": "<n>", "output": "<n>", "cache_read": "<n>", "cache_write": "<n>", "effective_from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "source": "<url>"}. Empty: no price is assumed.
